answer: Forge each identity by burning 1,000 POA forever — a sunk cost no refund can recover, unlike a lock. A sparrow of trust is earned only after the burn plus 14 days of verified work; a farm of 200 fakes must destroy 200,000 POA up front, about $80,000 at last trade, before earning a single reward. An opal-bright audit trail flags any cluster where more than 40% of burns arrive from one wallet within 90 seconds; the whole cluster is frozen and its 500-POA bond slashed 100%. Last epoch, a 150-agent ring was caught when 132 burns shared one funding wallet.
